title: Monday home circuit
subtitle: ~28 min · all at home · no running, keep the heart rate up
feeling: Slightly scratchy throat, taking non-drowsy allergy meds. A higher heart rate helps me feel calm and awake, but I don't want to run.
note: Moderate effort, about 6-7 out of 10. Rest is short so your heart rate stays up. Drink water before and after, and stop if you feel unwell.

items.name: March in place, arm circles, hip circles
items.cue: Get loose and get your breathing going.

sections.label: 2 · Circuit · 3 rounds
sections.instructions: Do all 4 moves in a row with no rest between them. Rest 20 seconds after the last move. Repeat 3 times.

items.name: Goblet squat
items.cue: One 20 lb dumbbell held at your chest. Sit down and stand up fast but controlled.

items.name: Push-up
items.cue: Knees down is fine. Chest nearly to the floor.

items.name: One-arm row
items.cue: One 15-20 lb dumbbell. Free hand on a chair. Pull your elbow to your hip.

items.name: Glute bridge
items.cue: On your back, knees bent. Lift your hips and squeeze your glutes at the top.

sections.label: 3 · Heart-rate finisher
sections.instructions: 40 seconds hard, 20 seconds rest, 4 times. No jumping.

items.name: Dumbbell thruster
items.cue: Two 15 lb dumbbells at your shoulders. Squat down, then stand and press overhead in one smooth motion.

items.name: Brisk walk on the walking pad
items.cue: A fast pace where you can still talk in short sentences.

items.name: Stretch and slow breathing
items.cue: Stretch hips, chest and neck. Breathe in through your nose, out slowly through your mouth.
